name_input: RAMA CYLINDERS PVT. LTD.; RAMA CYLINDERS PVT.LTD; RAMA CYLINDERS PVT LTD.; RAMA CYLINDERS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'rama-cylinders-private-limited' (address 181-A2, Maker Tower-E, Cuffe Parade) shows "Total Shipments 132 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26", 8 trading partners, 13 port lanes. Exact rows seen (5 of 132): "2026-02-26 | RAMA CYLINDERS PRIVATE LIMITED | DAINA GAS | EMPTY HIGH PRESSURE CYL 46.7 LTRS, W.C.232 MM DIA INDL. 02 GAS WITH NECKRING INDO FAB VALVE- LOKSAN LCS INCRXB | India -> BHIMTAR BHUTAN, BHUTAN | HS 73110030 | BOL 1035086"; "2026-01-28 | RAMA CYLINDERS PRIVATE LIMITED | VENETA COLLAUDI S.R.L. | EMPTY HIGH PRESSURE SEAMLESS GAS CYLINDER - WC 10 LTRS 139.7 MM DIA GAS CO2 | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Genoa, ITALY | HS 73110030 | BOL 9120077"; "2025-12-23 | RAMA CYLINDERS PRIVATE LIMITED | DILIGENCE CONGLOMERATE CO.LTD | EMPTY HIGH PRESSURE SEAMLESS GAS CYLINDER WC 12 LTRS 165MM DIA CNG GAS | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India -> Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania | HS 73110030 | BOL 8152461". Buyer-side counterparties listed with shipment counts: "EGYPTIAN INTERNATIONAL GAS ... 13", "NATURAL GAS VEHICLES COMPANY ... 18", "PANAMA CNG CONVERSION ... 13", "SARMANO ENGINEERING SERVICES PVT LTD ... 5" (Dhaka, Bangladesh), "BABA OXYGEN AND ALLIED INDUSTRIES PVT.LTD. ... 4" (Biratnagar, Nepal). Source counter: page claims 132 records; only 5 dated rows were visible in the free view (plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows without dates).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, and the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down or returned only irrelevant 'Rama' deity results. The only India-side activity visible in the customs view is inbound: "2026-01-19 | GOMG SRL | RAMA CYLINDERS PRIVATE LIMITED | CYLINDER HYDRAULIC 50/28/550 MM STROKE ... | Genoa, ITALY -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | HS 84122100 | BOL 6989075" and "2026-01-14 | LUXFER CANADA LTD | RAMA CYLINDERS PRIVATE LIMITED | G-STOR PRO CYLINDER ... | CALGARY, Canada -> SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | HS 76130099 | BOL 6900353" — i.e. imports of steel tubes/cylinders from CHENGDE JIANLONG SPECIAL STEEL, TIANJIN PIPE INTERNATIONAL, JINGJIANG SPECIAL STEEL, JIANGYIN SHIMING STEEL TUBE, not domestic sales. Domestic supply therefore not established, not denied.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: outbound high-pressure seamless gas cylinders under HS 73110030 to Bhutan (Bhimtar, B/L 1035086, 2026-02-26), Italy (Genoa, B/L 9120077, 2026-01-28) and Tanzania (Dar es Salaam, B/L 8152461, 2025-12-23), with repeat buyer relationships in Egypt, Panama, Bangladesh and Nepal. Declared HS 731100 is consistent with the observed 8-digit code 73110030 — no HS correction needed. Caveat on evidence depth: ImportKey's free view advertises 132 records but exposes only 5 dated rows, so the 132 figure is the portal's counter, not a count I verified; B/L numbers and dates above are quoted verbatim from the visible rows. Domestic (India) supply evidence is null — GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP contracts and annual-report splits are not public in the sources reachable in this session (403s and a dead search backend), so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'; absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales. Revenue/export volume figures: null, not published in accessible sources. Role: manufacturer (own plant, imports raw steel tube and cylinder components, exports finished cylinders) — not a trader.
